title: Boom Blaster
body:
"Load this launcher up with all sorts of explosives! From bombs, to dynamite, to fireworks, this thing shoots 'em all. Just be careful where you point the darn thing! Load explosives by hovering over them."

Description

Boom Blaster is a piece of equipment that can be used to shoot any type of explosive, it can also store any amount of any type. it can be purchased for $14,000 at Dugg's Digging.

To load the Boom Blaster just hover over a loadable explosive, if it is loadable, it will turn white, click to add to the ammunition.

While it's assumed to take any explosive, it is unknown if it is possible to load the Nuke.
